scope: Primary fully enabled packaged UI. D/B external dependencies are explicitly offline; no live acceptance is inferred.

J01.observations: Actual Add/helper failure, protected login/route commands through production boundary with offline donor, identity mismatch/inventory recovery, repair/upgrade, archive/reactivate/removal, unaffected account and persisted restart.

J02.observations: 50 accounts/1200 real IDB rows, global filters, cross-page selection/restart, invalid intake recovery, frozen 1001-input preview, actual interrupted chunk persistence, healthy explicit account alongside unknown account, original bytes.

J03.observations: One connect/import scope review, full >100-file source tree/binary download, prompt conflict/lost ACK, empty-repo starter, rename/create-separate identity choices, later-main intake and READY, source/operation search, restart. Remote Git/provider are offline models.

J04.observations: Actual primary full-source/history review, paused/resumed autonomous background workflow, newer READY, human dirty-source hold/adopt/retest, exact approval and clean-bulk frozen selection, lost ACK and process restart. AI/editor/Git/provider facts are offline models.

J05.observations: 55 accounts/1200 generators; global/account/generator pause, defaults/custom/reset, capacity bounds, source-save versus complete-feed placement, backoff/stale/lost-ACK recovery. Actual command-free background intervals and OS restart with pulse-disabled negative; no live 24h/72h or bridge proof.

J06.observations: Actual manual/daily disk archive, file picker/reopen, corruption/retry, isolated functional IDB restore, existing/fresh/removed-account restore choices, safety copy, binary/source/history/UID/tag preservation, interrupted continuation, inactive controller, attention/report/search and OS restart. Subsequent provider/route confirmation remains external.

J07.observations: Actual built-in/custom saved-view query/layout and independent canonical Release/Refresher/Attention/Observed facets, invalid input recovery, column order/width/visibility, cross-view selection, native keyboard scroll/details/modal focus/panel resize, theme/density and cold restart. All six primary routes/seven settings categories at actual 200% full-page Firefox zoom and effective 320 CSSpx.
